text:
maya: Heads-up, deploy-bot flagged a chart version skew between eu-west and us-east during the canary run :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary started for service/order-ingress v2.4.1 in eu-west (10% traffic). us-east shows v2.4.0 still deployed.
jon: Ack. Is the CI promoted artifact identical?
lee: CI has v2.4.1 in the registry, looks like us-east promotion didn't finish.
sophia: What does the canary policy say — pin older or force promote regionally?
maya: Our default is to avoid cross-region version mismatches. Prefer pinning to v2.4.0 in eu-west if rollback is quick. But if v2.4.1 is a security/bug fix we might need to promote us-east asap.
samira: Quick check: the release notes show a fix for N+1 DB connections that caused spike under load. That's severe for order-ingress.
jon: Can we shadow canary in us-east instead of full promote? Start a 1% shadow that mirrors requests to a non-prod path to verify?
lee: We can do shadowing by duplicating traffic to a staging pool in us-east and run the same container image. Needs a values override: `replicaCount: 1`, `service.type: ClusterIP`, `routing.shadow: true`
maya: Good plan. Spin shadow job in us-east for v2.4.1 and run the same load tests used during CI. If green, promote and update changelog.
deploy-bot: Shadow job created: kube job/order-ingress-shadow-us-east-3071234567. Logs available at https://logs.internal/redwood/order-ingress/3071234567
sophia: Also note change window is tonight 23:00 UTC. We should avoid manual promote during the day unless critical. Can we run shadow now and promote during window?
samira: Yes, shadow now. If metrics look good, schedule promote at 23:00 UTC with an automated canary 10% -> 50% rollout.
jon: Who's owning release notes assembly? I can draft a short blurb about the DB connection fix + rollback instructions.
maya: Assign to jon. Also add instructions for ops: how to manually pin back to v2.4.0 if rollout alerts trigger.
jon: Drafted note snippet:
```
- order-ingress 2.4.1: Fixes N+1 DB connection spike under certain load patterns. Rollout plan: scheduled promote (23:00 UTC) with automated canary (10% -> 50%) and 30m observation. Rollback: `helm upgrade --install order-ingress ./chart --version 2.4.0 --set image.tag=2.4.0 -n prod`
```
lee: Add a note to the release page to include the values diff we used for shadowing:
```
values-overrides:
  routing:
    shadow: true
  replicaCount: 1
```
sophia: After shadow completes, tag the release candidate in the release channel and link the runbook.
maya: If shadow shows any DB connection error spike, we abort promote and open a P1. If it's clean, approve promote at 22:50 to let deploy-bot start at 23:00.
deploy-bot: Shadow job completed: exit=0, latency_p50 unchanged, connections stable. Metrics: cpu +1%, conn_error_rate unchanged.
samira: Metrics look good from the quick run. I can run a longer 10m synthetic load in 15m to confirm.
jon: Cool. I'll finish release notes and send for review. Add a manual rollback snippet and contact list in the notes (paging ops rotations).
maya: One more: make sure the chart version bump is included in the Helm repo index; we've seen delays there before. Confirm `helm repo update` step in the promote job.
lee: I'll patch the promote job to perform `helm repo update` and check artifact hash before switching.
sophia: Thanks — please add a short preflight in the promote job:
```
helm repo update
helm search repo redwood/order-ingress --versions | grep 2.4.1
```
maya: Ok team. Plan: shadow run now (done), extended synthetic test in 15m, promote at 23:00 UTC if green, jon publishes release notes with rollback snippets and contact list. Leave the pin decision until we see shadow metrics; default is promote if no regression. :thumbsup:
jon: Roger. I'll post the release note draft in #eng-releases for a quick thumbs up by 21:30 UTC.
samira: running extended synth now, will report back ~3071234585.
deploy-bot: Extended synth finished: no regressions observed.
maya: Approve promote. ops on-call be ready at 23:00.
lee: Promote job updated with `helm repo update` preflight.
jon: Release notes posted: https://docs.internal/releases/order-ingress-2.4.1 (please review).
maya: Thanks all. I'll close this thread after deploy-bot posts final promote start.
